title: pauseCampaign request
description: POST /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}:pause - request. Pauses the campaign saga (also automatic on open circuit / downstream latency, DISENO S5 (h)).
$comment: Source: DISENO S5 (b) BackfillCampaign, (c) campaign/firm_progress AP-D3, (d) StartCampaignUseCase/PauseCampaignUseCase, (e) operator APIs, (h); PRD RF-014, RF-083, RNF-035, SLO-06; US-02.2.1. Audience: OPERATOR (operator console / role-restricted). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); firmId stays in the cell. Idempotency: Idempotency-Key required; idempotent transition (already PAUSED -> same 200); pausing cancels the in-flight fan-out jobs of the campaign (CancelFanOutJob.v1, DEC-24). Pagination: n/a.

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120). idempotency-key is required on every write (DISENO 3.8.5, DEC-35).
